description: Official EU VAT rates per member state on a given date from the European Commission Taxes in Europe Database (TEDB): standard rate, reduced, super-reduced and parking rates, regional standard rates (e.g. Canary Islands entries) and the categories with reduced rates. Source data is supplied by Member States (CC BY 4.0).

countries.description: EU member states, ISO alpha-2 (Greece = EL or GR, Northern Ireland = XI). Omit for all 27.

date.description: Situation date YYYY-MM-DD (default today). Historic dates supported.

name: eu_vat_standard_rates
